lines.text: Many learners say: He is old as me.
Better: He is as old as me.
The second! She is as tall as me.

data.right: He is as old as me.

native.tip: Türkçede “benim kadar yaşlı” deriz, “kadar” bir kez gelir; İngilizcede “as” iki kez gerekir: “He is as old as me.”
native.caption: “He is old as me” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede eşitlik için “as” iki kez söylenir: “as old as”. Doğrusu “He is as old as me.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “She is as tall as me.” “As” iki kez gelir. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: Use “as” two times: “He is as old as me.”
en.caption: Do you say “He is old as me”? 😅 In English we say “as” two times, like “as old as” in this sentence. The right sentence is “He is as old as me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
